subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated / VPC - post-call follow-up

Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood follow-up & post-call recap (VPC option)

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Requirements: low-latency inference for customer-facing search, strict data isolation for PII, expected ~500k tokens/day steady state with spikes during product demos.
- Current priorities: security/compliance and predictable unit economics.
- Suggested path: start on Hosted API for quick integration + PoC, evaluate Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) for predictable throughput, and scope Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) if Acme requires network isolation and dedicated control plane.

Attachments: redwood-postcall-recap.pdf (call notes + proposed timeline)

Next steps I propose:
1) I can put together a short proposal with Dedicated vs VPC cost/benefit and a recommended rollout plan - tgt delivery by next Tue (7/6).
2) Technical touchpoint: loop in Vivek (cc'd) for a 30-min tech Q&A on the VPC/on-prem options if you want deeper ops details.
3) If you prefer, we can start a limited Hosted API pilot this month to validate latency and integration surface.

Would you prefer I send the proposal or schedule the tech Q&A first?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Subject: Quick check - VPC / Private deployment interest and timeline?

Hi Sarah,

Just bumping this thread - wanted to see if Acme is leaning toward starting with Hosted/Dedicated or if you want to evaluate Private (VPC/on-prem) as part of the initial procurement. A couple notes to help you and David: 

- Typical timelines: Dedicated (reserved capacity) onboarding: ~2-3 weeks (contracting + capacity provisioning) if customer provides basic networking info. Private VPC: ~4-8 weeks depending on region and SOC/KMS integrations; on-prem packages add lead time for air-gapped installs.
- Security artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 summary, network architecture doc, and prior customer references (we can anonymize).
- If timing/priority changed, I can pare the proposal to just the Hosted/Dedicated path to speed procurement.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min call this week with Vivek to walk David through the VPC architecture and the expected operational impacts. Would Thu 7/9 or Fri 7/10 work for you?

If I don't hear back, I'll follow up one more time next week and then pause outreach.

Appreciate it,
Marissa
